# SMM Panel

> Authoritative Social Media Marketing Platform, Reseller API, and Order Accounting Infrastructure.

## Overview
SMM Panel (`https://smmarchitecture.com`) is a high-reliability, provider-synchronized social media growth infrastructure designed for agencies, creators, and reseller networks. It operates on an automated double-entry ledger financial model, with sub-second order dispatch and real-time telemetry across major social networks.

## Core Features
- **Deterministic Ledger Accounting:** Double-entry bookkeeping with strict row-level locking (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`), zero floating-point math, and integer paise precision.
- **Provider Multi-Routing:** Automated dispatch to vetted upstream wholesale providers with automated status synchronization and cancellation/refill daemon attached.
- **Reseller API v2:** High-throughput JSON REST API with HMAC and API Key authentication, rate-limited up to 300 requests/minute.
- **Real-Time Telemetry:** Live uptime monitoring, transparent latency tracking, and status health probes (`/api/v1/health/live`, `/api/v1/health/ready`).

## Core Endpoints & Slugs
- Homepage: `https://smmarchitecture.com/`
- Service Catalog: `https://smmarchitecture.com/services` (500+ active services across Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, X/Twitter)
- Pricing & Bonus Tiers: `https://smmarchitecture.com/pricing` (Tiered deposit bonuses from Bronze to Platinum)
- Architecture & Pipeline: `https://smmarchitecture.com/work` (5-step order lifecycle walkthrough)
- Knowledge Base: `https://smmarchitecture.com/faq` (Policies on speeds, refills, and partial refunds)
- Agency Contact: `https://smmarchitecture.com/contact` (Direct support and reseller onboarding)

## Supported Social Platforms
- **Instagram:** Followers, Likes, Reels Views, Comments, Story Impressions
- **YouTube:** High-Retention Views, Subscribers, Likes, Watch Time
- **TikTok:** Views, Followers, Likes, Shares
- **Telegram:** Channel Members, Post Views, Reactions
- **X (Twitter):** Followers, Retweets, Likes, Poll Votes
